A [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] '''village''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. Its inhabitants included [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]] and his assistant [[Medcha Wanto/Legends|Medcha Wanto]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was visited by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as they attempted to negotiate peace between the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] and the native Talz.<ref name="Trespass" />
